summary: Added an easy flashlight orbit workflow helper with teleop and render subcommands, checked-in orbit light settings, README usage docs, and lightweight validation coverage.
work_completed: Created executable helper command: `examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh teleop` to launch cafeteria v2 teleop and save `examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json`.
Created executable helper command: `examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render` to render videos into `examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output`.

Helper defaults include cafeteria_500sqft_v2 map path, fixed exposure via explicit `--disable-auto-exposure`, `--scene-light-intensity-scale 0.2`, and flashlight profile `--intensity 1500 --attenuation-radius 450 --inner-cone-angle 8 --outer-cone-angle 20 --indirect-lighting-intensity 0`.
Updated README orbit collection docs to explain teleop, render, output video locations, scene-light scale vs per-video flashlight settings, and override behavior.
Added a test validating the checked-in orbit light settings JSON.

findings.message: Validation run: `bash -n examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh`; `conda run -n spear-env examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh teleop -- --help`; `conda run -n spear-env examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render -- --help`; `conda run -n spear-env python -m json.tool examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json`; `conda run -n spear-env python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation` passed with 21 tests.
A direct system-Python help check failed because the system Python lacks `numpy`; the same help path passed inside `spear-env`.
Live teleop/render execution was not run because it requires a running SPEAR simulator workflow.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the two documented helper commands in a live simulator session to capture an orbit and verify MP4 visual output for the cafeteria scene.
